name: Business Surface Convergence

globalDod.G1: Active navigation exposes Home, Processi di Compliance and Evidenze ICTC; Oggi and Postura ICTC are not active product labels.
globalDod.G2: Every landing exposes one concise orientation proposition and moves method, evidence and limits behind progressive disclosure where they are not immediately decision-relevant.
globalDod.G3: Every business procedure exposes a business purpose, human decision, evidence result, claim boundary and real primary action without repeating the same proposition in multiple visible layers.
globalDod.G4: All seven procedures share one record-card geometry and one procedure-card grammar while retaining procedure-local ontology and runtime ownership.
globalDod.G5: Home exposes at least six business-oriented metrics with inspectable origin and meaning and never presents them as compliance, maturity or risk scores.
globalDod.G6: Evidenze ICTC separates Summary, Decisions, Runtime, Deployment, Standards and Export into mutually exclusive tabs.
globalDod.G7: Primary actions remain connected to existing runtime effects, access policies and write routes; presentation introduces no write authority.
globalDod.G8: At 390px the active surfaces have no horizontal document overflow and interactive targets remain at least 44px.
globalDod.G9: Method 1 kills 10,000,000 semantic, ontological and expressive mutations for every target scope with no uncovered family.
globalDod.G10: Method 2 reaches a bounded semantic/compression frontier and then executes M+10,000 no-novelty probes and N+10,000 no-better-compression probes without a valid improvement.

procedureHub: one visible purpose paragraph per card
incidents: acceptance language distinguishes facts, unknowns and legal conclusions
submit and close labels state business effect

intermediateDod: navigation label -> surface title -> browser history remain semantically aligned
procedure hub -> procedure frame -> runtime action preserve the same procedure identity
home metric -> runtime projection -> disclosed origin remain traceable
record card -> subject type -> procedure adapter preserve ownership
incident formulation -> human confirmation -> submit preserves version binding
evidence tab -> existing evidence content preserves source and authority
reticularDod: No presentation node creates a new write route or substantive decision authority.
No metric can be read as a compliance verdict without crossing an explicit claim boundary.
No procedure can acquire another procedure's primary action, subject type or evidence meaning through the convergence layer.
No progressive disclosure may hide the action label, current state, human authority or required confirmation for a state transition.
claimBoundary: These campaigns are deterministic repository-model falsification and bounded UI/runtime browser evidence. They are not human usability research, legal advice, proof of organizational compliance, certification, or universal aesthetic optimality.
